# utils_version (Data Source)

Computes ecosystem-specific version strings (dotnet, debian, nuget, npm) from a common set of build inputs (base version, revision/build numbers, git commit sha, and release channel).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_version` (String) Base version in `major.minor` format (e.g. `"1.2"`). The revision number is appended as the patch component for all ecosystems, and the build number is appended as a fourth component for dotnet.
- `build_number` (Number) CI build number. Used as the fourth numeric component for dotnet, and as the prerelease build identifier for nuget/npm.
- `rev_number` (Number) Revision number (e.g. git commit count), used as the patch component of all computed versions.

### Optional

- `arch` (String) Target architecture, echoed back as `debian.arch` for building package filenames. Not embedded into any version string.
- `debian_date` (String) Date used in the debian `~git<date>` snapshot segment, in `YYYYMMDD` format. Defaults to the current UTC date; override for reproducible builds.
- `debian_revision` (String) Debian package revision (the trailing `-N` in the version string). Defaults to `"1"`.
- `git_sha` (String) Short git commit sha. Omitted from all output version strings if not set.
- `release_channel` (String) One of `"release"`, `"beta"`, or `"alpha"`. Defaults to `"alpha"`. `"release"` produces plain numeric versions; `"beta"`/`"alpha"` add a prerelease suffix.

### Read-Only

- `debian` (Attributes) Version string for a Debian/APT package. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--debian))
- `dotnet` (Attributes) Version strings for .NET assembly/package versioning. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dotnet))
- `npm` (Attributes) Version string for an npm package (SemVer 2.0.0). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--npm))
- `nuget` (Attributes) Version string for a NuGet package (SemVer 2.0.0). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nuget))

<a id="nestedatt--debian"></a>
### Nested Schema for `debian`

Read-Only:

- `arch` (String) Echoes the `arch` input, null if not set.
- `version` (String) e.g. `1.2.3-1` on the release channel, or `1.2.3~alpha~git20240101.abc1234-1` otherwise.


<a id="nestedatt--dotnet"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dotnet`

Read-Only:

- `app_version` (String) Purely numeric 4-part version (`major.minor.rev.build`), suitable for `AssemblyVersion`/`FileVersion`.
- `info_version` (String) `major.minor.rev` on the release channel, or `major.minor-<channel>[-<sha>]` otherwise.


<a id="nestedatt--npm"></a>
### Nested Schema for `npm`

Read-Only:

- `version` (String) e.g. `1.2.3` on the release channel, or `1.2.3-alpha.4+abc1234` otherwise.


<a id="nestedatt--nuget"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nuget`

Read-Only:

- `version` (String) e.g. `1.2.3` on the release channel, or `1.2.3-alpha.4+abc1234` otherwise.
